crossRefs.note: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel stood with him out of all their territory.
crossRefs.keyword: A.M. 3030. B.C. 974. resorted to him. Heb. presentedthemselves to him

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel stood with him out of all their territory.
translations.bsb: Moreover, the priests and Levites from all their districts throughout Israel stood with Rehoboam.
translations.kjv: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.
translations.asv: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their border.
